title: First-Recovery Allowance on Gift Cards & Store Credit Recoveries
content:
A first-recovery allowance is taken off the rejected part plus the fee part of a Gift Cards & Store Credit recovery of instant Return Store Credit, never below zero, before the limit to the store credit's current balance applies. The allowance depends on the customer's record on their other Returns & Exchanges returns.

## Allowance

| Inspected lines rejected or accepted with a fee on the customer's other returns in the last 24 months | Allowance (USD) |
|---|---|
| None | 5.00 |
| Exactly one | 2.00 |
| Two or more | No allowance |

The lines counted are return lines inspected with the outcome rejected or accepted with a fee, dated in the last 24 months (fewer than 24 whole months before the recovery date), on returns other than the return the recovery is for. Lines on the return being recovered never count. The count is of lines, not of returns: two such lines on one other return count as two.

## Effect on figures (hypothetical recoveries)

| Rejected part plus fee part | Such lines on other returns | Allowance | Amount before the balance limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 57.50 | 0 | 5.00 | 52.50 |
| 57.50 | 1 | 2.00 | 55.50 |
| 57.50 | 2 (both on one other return) | none | 57.50 |
| 3.00 | 0 | 5.00 | 0.00 (never below zero) |

Because the allowance comes off before the balance limit, a store credit with a current balance of 40.00 and an amount before the limit of 52.50 is still limited to 40.00.
